# Morpheus MyProvider

> Hosted operator GUI at https://myprovider.mor.org for onboarding and managing Morpheus provider nodes. Basic Auth to your proxy-router — not a browser wallet. Prefer bidding on existing model Ids from active.mor.org.

This site is a **static SPA**. For agents: start with this file, then fetch the full recipe.

## Agent entry points (fetch these)

- [Full onboarding recipe (llms-full)](https://myprovider.mor.org/llms-full.txt): 3-step bootstrap — models/bids (MOR/hr + per-bid backend) → secrets → deploy
- [AGENTS.md](https://myprovider.mor.org/AGENTS.md): Same guidance in AGENTS.md form
- [Onboarding markdown](https://myprovider.mor.org/onboarding.md): Human/agent readable steps by deploy path
- [This index (llms.txt)](https://myprovider.mor.org/llms.txt)

## Live GUI

- [myprovider.mor.org](https://myprovider.mor.org) — interactive onboarding (SecretVM / Container / Release / GitHub). Secrets typed in the UI are **session-only** (not stored on a server).

- Status UI: https://active.mor.org/status

- All models: https://active.mor.org/all_models.json

## Hard rules for agents

1. Prefer **bid on an existing model Id** from active.mor.org — do not mint duplicate marketplace models.
2. Bid prices in the GUI are **MOR/hour**; tooling converts to wei/sec for the chain.
3. Config `modelName` is the **backend** model id (Venice/local) — not the Morpheus marketplace Name.
4. MyProvider auth = HTTP Basic Auth to the node's admin API (COOKIE_CONTENT), **not** MetaMask.
5. Hosted myprovider.mor.org requires **HTTPS** to the node (SecretVM Traefik fits; HTTP-only → desktop app or local npm run dev).
6. Never invent contract addresses, chain IDs, or live prices — use nodedocs networks page and active.mor.org.
7. Opening a session escrows MOR; it does not "spend" it. There is no recover RPC — close the session.
8. There is **one** MyProvider site: https://myprovider.mor.org (no separate .dev host).
9. SecretVM: after the VM hostname appears, regenerate and re-paste the full secrets block (WEB_PUBLIC_URL).
